hook: A 1993 DOS game, rebuilt for a RISC-V FPGA.

beats.say: Bertrand Fan released an openFPGA core that plays the 1993 game SkyRoads on the Analogue Pocket.
It isn't an emulator. The FPGA hosts a small RISC-V system running the game's decompiled C code. The listing says the game is freeware.
Version 0.2.2 fixes music voices that went missing because sound-chip register writes were spaced too closely at the Pocket's 49 megahertz clock.
